listing.name: GoldenEye 007 / GoldenEye64Recomp (cblock85)
listing.summary: Native macOS and Linux port of GoldenEye 007 (N64) via static recompilation (N64Recomp + RT64). No emulator. Contains no ROM or game assets — you supply your own cartridge dump. Optional builds ship zero game code and recompile from your ROM at launch.
